data.one_liner: Cloudinary SDK for integrating image and video management, transformation, and optimization.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to integrate with Cloudinary to effortlessly optimize and transform cloud assets like images and videos. Provides widgets and utilities for generating Cloudinary URLs and rendering assets.
use_when: You are using Cloudinary as your cloud media storage and management backend.
You need to apply image or video transformations and optimizations on the fly within a Flutter app.
avoid_when: You are storing assets locally or on a different cloud provider without Cloudinary integration.
You only need basic local image picking or simple asset caching without remote transformations.
strengths: Streamlines integration with Cloudinary cloud service.
Provides built-in widgets like CldImageWidget with transformation capabilities.
Supports video analytics and video player integration.
weaknesses: Tied strictly to the Cloudinary ecosystem.
Limited documentation provided within the README outside of basic setup and usage.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding dependencies to pubspec.yaml and initializing the Cloudinary instance with your cloud name.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need to download and cache network images from standard URLs without relying on the Cloudinary backend.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to process and manipulate images locally on the device rather than via a cloud service.
